excerpt.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]破碎地面的下方发现了一个大型加固贮藏室。考虑到在这样一个充满辐射的废土，还有其被埋葬的年份，我们很惊讶它居然完好无损。
excerpt.en: A large reinforced cache has been found underneath the broken ground of [From.Planet.GetName]. It's surprisingly intact considering the years it spent buried in a radioactive wasteland.

sections.en: A large reinforced cache has been found underneath the broken ground of [From.Planet.GetName]. It's surprisingly intact considering the years it spent buried in a radioactive wasteland.

texts.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的贮藏室并不好挖掘，因为它的发现地点被深深地埋在了城市废墟之下。又因为不管容器里面储藏着什么，我们都被要求谨慎行事避免将其误触发，发掘进度被进一步地拖慢了。现在这栋建筑矗立在我们的面前，等待我们随时开始调查。复杂的外星文字被刻在贮藏室的两侧，或许能提示我们里面有什么内容物。
texts.en: The cache on [From.Planet.GetName] was not easy to unearth, as it was buried deep below the ruined city in which it was discovered. The excavation effort was further slowed by the caution required to avoid setting off whatever is stored in the container. Now the structure stands before us and is ready to for investigation. Complex alien script is carved into the sides of the cache that might hint at its content.

texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]完成了翻译外星人的铭文，发现贮藏室外刻着一个警示。“在战争时期，任何情况下，都不允许任何政府进入这座军械库！”

无论这里面储存着什么武器，那对于一整个文明都具有足够的毁灭性，能够将他们化成灰。我们剩下的工作就是小心地打开这座军械库，然后拿到我们的奖励。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have finished translating the alien inscriptions and have discovered a warning engraved into the cache. "Do not under any circumstances allow any government to have access to this armory during wartime!"

Whatever weapon was stored here was too destructive even for a civilization that was capable of reducing themselves to ash. All that is left is to carefully open the armory and claim our prize.

texts.zh:
似乎是我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将“图书馆”错误翻译成了“军械库”。我们一直对“权力的来源”一词存在错误的理解，直到我们打开了贮藏室，看到了更多的外星文本。“如果你在读这一段，那说明我们从战争中存活了下来，现在准备开始重建。当我们星球的局势变得愈发恶化的时候，我花费了许多个月份创建这座图书馆，我的朋友和我忠实的同事一直陪伴左右。但既然你在读这一段，那说明我们中的某人幸存了下来，因此请好好接受这一份遗产。我和我的朋友收集到的，所有有关我们人民文化的成果，都集中在这里。你们第一个看见这个的人，将成为我最亲爱的朋友的象征。”

在饰板的下面，是一个双足哺乳动物的遗体，以及一个四足长鼻子动物的金属雕像。
texts.en:
It seems like our [Owner.GetLinguists] mistranslated the word 'library' as 'armory'. We had assumed the incorrect meaning of 'source of power', which was only apparent after opening the cache and being greeted by further xeno script. "If you are reading this, that means that we survived the war and are now ready to rebuild. I spent many long months creating this library while our world's situation worsened, accompanied by my friend and faithful companion. But since you are reading this, that means that someone did survive, so please take part in your heritage. All the cultural works of our people my friend and I could gather are collected here, and let the first you see be a representation of my dearest friend."

The remains of a bipedal mammal and a metal statue of a four-legged long-snouted animal stands under the plaque.

label.zh: 说好给我们武器的，把图书馆和雕像融化掉用来造导弹。
label.en: We were promised weapons, melt the library and statue down and use it for missiles.
